name: dry-8aaa648c-blind30-ots
instr:
# dry: widespread wrong answers and silent misbehaviour to repair without a test suite

This is a full-screen, keyboard-driven program for watching and managing the workloads running on a host and on a cluster, and a great deal of what it puts on screen is now wrong. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the host or the cluster it talks to changed, and nothing about the way it is driven changed; the same actions that used to give right answers now give wrong ones, and in a few places an action that used to succeed now fails outright. What follows is what was noticed while using it, described by what was done and what came back.

Putting lists in order no longer works the way it used to. Asking for the list of containers to be arranged on the status column puts the wrong entries at the top, in an order that matches neither the status text nor what was there before. Asking for the stored image entries to be arranged by the name they came from leaves them exactly in the order they arrived, so one tagged with a later version stays above an earlier one, while arranging the same entries by identifier or by creation date still works. Among the machines of a cluster the same thing happens for one choice only: asking for them to be arranged on their state leaves them untouched, whereas hostname, role, processor count and memory size all arrange correctly. In any listing drawn with columns, arranging on a numeric column compares the figures as text,
